products.overview:
The Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer is Heidolph's lightest overhead stirrer at 2.3 kg, delivering 65 Ncm of torque across 20 to 2,000 rpm for viscosities up to 10,000 mPas.
A magnetic stirrer works until the medium gets thick, the volume gets large, or the solids settle. Then it stops working, quietly, and you find out later.
Torque where magnetic stirring gives up. A stir bar decouples in a viscous medium. A driven shaft does not.
The stand, boss head, stirring shaft, and stirring element are NOT included.
features: 65 Ncm of Torque: Torque, not speed, is what decides whether an overhead stirrer can do your job.
Keyless Quick-Action Chuck: The Quick Chuck opens and closes by hand, with no key and no tool.
Stirrer Shafts from 0.5 to 10.5 mm: The chuck clamps shafts from 0.5 mm up to 10.5 mm.
Max Button: One press takes the drive to its maximum 2,000 rpm immediately.
Viscosity to 10,000 mPas: The drive handles media up to 10,000 mPas.
Automatic Overload Cut-Out: If the load exceeds what the drive can deliver, the motor cuts out automatically.
Software Motor Monitoring: The motor is monitored in software, and a fault produces an error message.
2.3 kg, the Lightest Hei-TORQUE: The drive can be moved, mounted, and dismantled easily by one person.
Electronic Speed Control to +/-1%: Speed runs from 20 to 2,000 rpm under electronic control.
RS232 Interface: This configuration includes an RS232 interface.
applications: Viscous Media: 65 Ncm of torque drives a shaft through media up to 10,000 mPas.
Suspensions and Slurries: The Max button reslurries settled solids in a short burst.
Larger Volumes: Up to 25 litres in water, well beyond a magnetic stirrer reach.
Homogenisation: A driven shaft with the right element homogenises where a stir bar cannot.
Closed Systems: The 2.3 kg drive can be mounted into closed systems and enclosures.
Fume Hood and Awkward Locations: Light enough to install and dismantle single-handed in tight spaces.
Continuous Stirring: Rated for continuous operation, with a certificate available.

faqs.question: What is the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer used for?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer is Heidolph's lightest overhead stirrer, used for stirring media that a magnetic stirrer cannot turn. It delivers 65 Ncm of torque across 20 to 2,000 rpm, for viscosities up to 10,000 mPas or volumes up to 25 litres in water.

faqs.question: What is the maximum torque of the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The maximum torque of the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer is 65 Ncm. Torque, rather than speed, is the specification that determines whether an overhead stirrer can turn a given medium.

faqs.question: Can the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer stir 25 litres of a viscous medium?
faqs.answer: No. The Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer handles viscosities up to 10,000 mPas or volumes up to 25 litres in water. These are two separate ceilings on the same 65 Ncm drive, not a combined capability.

faqs.question: What is included with the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer?
faqs.answer: The Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer is supplied as a drive unit. The stand, boss head, stirring shaft, and stirring element are separate items and are not included.

faqs.answer: The part number of the Hei-Torque Core with RS232 Overhead Stirrer is 501-60430-00.
